cases.purpose: Listing, no-act and exact erasure of the ext magic through a disposable loop block node, and a silent repeat.
cases.oracle: util-linux 2.41 wipefs on a loop device carrying an ext2 filesystem made by e2fsprogs with a fixed UUID and label, and a full device byte comparison against the saved image.
cases.comparison: Parity of output (device name normalised), status and empty stderr; complete device bytes before and after erasure.

files.device-bytes.py:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Compares a whole device with a saved image: byte-for-byte ("original") or
# with exactly the ext magic at 0x438 zeroed ("erased").
import pathlib, sys
mode, image, device = sys.argv[1:]
expected = bytearray(pathlib.Path(image).read_bytes())
if mode == 'erased':
    if expected[0x438:0x43a] != b'\x53\xef':
        raise SystemExit('saved image has no ext magic')
    expected[0x438:0x43a] = bytes(2)
with open(device, 'rb') as f:
    actual = f.read()
if actual != expected:
    raise SystemExit(f'{mode}: device bytes differ from the expected image')

cases.script:
set -eu
work=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d /tmp/wipefs-device-contract.XXXXXXXX)
d=
cleanup() {
  if [[ -n $d ]]; then /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$d" || exit 1; fi
  /usr/bin/rm -rf "$work"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
/usr/bin/truncate -s 1M "$work/image"
/usr/sbin/mkfs.ext2 -q -F -U 44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444 -L delta "$work/image"
/usr/bin/cp "$work/image" "$work/original"
d=$(/usr/sbin/losetup --find --show "$work/image")
[[ -b $d ]] || { echo 'loop setup failed' >&2; exit 1; }
/usr/bin/udevadm settle -t 10 >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
name() { /usr/bin/sed "s|$d|DEVICE|g; s|${d##*/}|DEVICE|g"; }
echo '[list]'; wipefs "$d" | name
echo '[no-act]'; wipefs -a -n "$d" | name
/usr/bin/python3 /tmp/parity-case/device-bytes.py original "$work/original" "$d"
echo '[erase]'; wipefs -a "$d" | name
/usr/bin/python3 /tmp/parity-case/device-bytes.py erased "$work/original" "$d"
echo '[again]'; wipefs -a "$d" | name
/usr/bin/python3 /tmp/parity-case/device-bytes.py erased "$work/original" "$d"
printf 'device byte contract ok\n'
